description: WINDHELM GLOBAL SURPLUS: A city on war footing. Weapons, Heavy Armor, and Ebony are abundant.
WINDHELM GLOBAL DEFICIT: The frozen tundra yields no crops. Wheat, wood, and cloth are expensive imports.
GLOOMBOUND MONOPOLY: Nearby Orc stronghold mines produce massive ebony. It is surprisingly cheap here.
THE WAR MACHINE: Oengul War-Anvil pumps out cheap steel for the rebellion. The market is flooded.
THE STARVATION: The Starvation Premium. Fresh crops are non-existent. Merchants pay double for bread.
VOLCANIC FLORA: These grow like weeds in the steam vents. Alchemists consider them low-value trash.
GREY QUARTER COMFORTS: High demand for luxury comforts and moon sugar to escape the cold and misery.
HORKER INDUSTRY: The only abundant meat source. Hunters on the coast flood the market.
